name: ANI-1x
fullName: Active-learning DFT data set of organic molecules
brief: Small organic molecules of carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen. Sampling was done via active learning; an ensemble of models flagged the conformations it disagreed on, and only those were sent for DFT labelling.
paperTitle: The ANI-1ccx and ANI-1x data sets, coupled-cluster and density functional theory properties for molecules
primaryPaper: Smith et al., The ANI-1ccx and ANI-1x data sets, Sci. Data 7:134 (2020).
